page.layout: Running head at top across the page: "Roma Irreconciliabilis." with page number 173 at right. Main text in one column, from top to bottom. Marginal notes in the right margin beside the column: "Poem. Illustr. Poetar. Ital." at top, and "Moresin. Scot. Orig. Pap." lower down. Catchword "cem" at the foot right.

p.i: Quod potui posui tibi fida Catella sepulchrum.
Digna magis cæli munere, quàm tumuli:

main_text.p: Nos (profanum vulgus scilicet) ocreas Martini, Georgij vaginam, cultrum Crispini calcearium, aut (quæ in quadam Liguriæ vrbe asseruari dicitur) caudam asini, cui insedit Christus, aut Rochi canem, aut Antonij suem colere nescimus: næ, ille Elephanti corio circumtectus est non suo, qui istoc fecerit: serio vero, vt geniculationes hasce legitimas demus ac pias; quis mihi Macarius inter tot densas arborum syluas veram cruPoem. Illustr. Poetar. Ital.Moresin. Scot. Orig. Pap.cem

page.notes: Marginal notes right: "Poem. Illustr. Poetar. Ital." and "Moresin. Scot. Orig. Pap."; the catchword "cem" is at the foot. Some faint show-through from the reverse page is ignored. Line-end hyphenation in "scili-cet", "di-citur", "Ca-nem" and "dein-sas" are rendered as printed.
